mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 indicates a supply-side shock that disrupts corporate production and increases input costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 100,000 monthly additions indicates a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 500,000 units signals weak consumer confidence and reduced residential investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 500.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-interest-rate regime (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), the elevated cost of borrowing constrains corporate investment and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 indicates a severe supply disruption that increases inflationary pressures and reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
